name: obsidian-vault-curator
description: Obsidian plugin that organises any vault folder with Claude: understands its use, discusses a structuring plan with the user, generates a canvas dashboard and aggregates new material after review.

scripts.dist: npm run build && node -e "for (const f of ['main.js','manifest.json','styles.css']) require('fs').copyFileSync(f, 'dist/' + f)"
